detail.description:
EasyWeek is an all-in-one booking and business management platform for salons, clinics, studios, and other appointment-based businesses across Europe and beyond. This MCP server exposes your EasyWeek workspace to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and others — so you can manage your business through natural conversation instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask your AI assistant things like:

- *"Show me all bookings for tomorrow at the downtown location."*
- *"When is Maria's next free slot for a 60-minute haircut?"*
- *"Cancel John's 3pm appointment and add a note that he rescheduled for next week."*
- *"Who are my top 10 customers by booking frequency this quarter?"*
- *"Create a booking for Anna Schmidt with stylist Petra on Friday at 10am for a color treatment."*

The server is production-ready, hosted in Germany on Hetzner infrastructure, GDPR/DSGVO compliant, and authenticated via OAuth — no API keys to copy, no config files to edit. Sign in with your EasyWeek account and you're connected.

### Who it's for

- **Business owners** running salons, barbershops, beauty studios, nail bars, massage and wellness centers, physiotherapy practices, dental and medical clinics, tattoo studios, fitness studios, yoga and pilates schools, driving schools, photo studios, repair shops, and any other appointment-based service business. No coding required.
- **Developers and agencies** building custom automations, internal tools, Slack bots, dashboards, or AI agents on top of EasyWeek data. The same MCP server that powers Claude conversations can power your scripts and workflows.
- **AI agent builders** preparing for agentic commerce — EasyWeek is the first booking platform with a production MCP server, making it the natural choice for agents that need to discover services, check availability, and create real bookings on behalf of consumers.

### 21 tools across 7 domains

- **Bookings (8 tools):** list, get, create, complete, cancel, change status, update notes, list statuses
- **Availability (2 tools):** real-time slot lookup and next-available-slot search
- **Customers (3 tools):** list, get details, view full booking history
- **Staff (2 tools):** list team members and staff categories with assigned services
- **Services (3 tools):** list services, categories, and payment accounts with prices and durations
- **Locations (2 tools):** list and get details for all branches
- **Workspace (1 tool):** company profile and metadata

All availability checks query live data — never stale caches — so AI agents always book against the real calendar.

### Why EasyWeek

EasyWeek is a European SaaS platform built around one principle: maximum simplicity for the people who actually run small service businesses. It includes a free plan, an embeddable booking widget, a built-in website builder with regional SEO domains across 28+ countries, SMS/email/WhatsApp notifications, POS, marketing tools, an open API with webhooks, Google Calendar and video conferencing sync (Meet, Zoom, Teams), object/resource booking, and a free onboarding service where account managers help you set everything up.

No commission on bookings. No vendor lock-in. Multilingual interface in 35+ languages.

If you don't have an EasyWeek account yet, you can create one for free at **easyweek.io** (or your local domain — easyweek.de, easyweek.fr, easyweek.es, easyweek.pl, easyweek.com.ua, easyweek.co.uk, and 20+ more) and connect this MCP server in under a minute.

### Setup

1. Create or log into your EasyWeek account.
2. In your MCP client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.), add the server URL: `https://mcp.easyweek.io/mcp`
3. Authorize with OAuth using your EasyWeek credentials.
4. Start managing your business in plain language.

That's it. No API keys, no config files, no terminal.

### Tech & compliance

- **Protocol:** Model Context Protocol (open standard by Anthropic)
- **Transport:** HTTPS, remote-hosted (no local install)
- **Auth:** OAuth 2.0
- **Data residency:** Germany (Hetzner)
- **Compliance:** GDPR / DSGVO
- **Pricing:** Included in EasyWeek plans, no per-request fees
- **Compatible clients:** Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Claude.ai, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and any MCP-compatible tool

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description:
Get information about the current workspace (company).

Returns the company name, slug, UUID, and profile details.
Use this first to understand which company you're connected to.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description:
List all locations (branches) of the company.

Returns location UUIDs, names, addresses, and contact details.
Location UUIDs are required for most other tools.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Get address, contact details, and settings for a specific location.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: list_staff
tools.description: List staff members working at a location with their roles and assigned services.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: list_staff_categories
tools.description: List staff categories (departments/roles) configured at a location.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List services offered at a location with prices, durations, and assigned staff.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: list_service_categories
tools.description: List service categories at a location. Use to group services when displaying to users.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: list_payment_accounts
tools.description: List payment accounts (cash, card, online) configured for a location.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: List available time slots for a service within a date range.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for times in the response (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin'). Defaults to the location's timezone.

range_end.description: End date of the availability window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Inclusive.

range_start.description: Start date of the availability window in YYYY-MM-DD format.

service_uuid.description: UUID of the service. Obtain from list_services for the location.

staffer_uuid.description: UUID of a specific staff member. Obtain from list_staff.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: get_next_available_slot
tools.description: Find the earliest available time slot for a service. Use when a user asks 'when can I book?'.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for times in the response (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin'). Defaults to the location's timezone.

service_uuid.description: UUID of the service. Obtain from list_services for the location.

staffer_uuid.description: UUID of a specific staff member. Obtain from list_staff.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings for the workspace, paginated, with status, customer, services, and times.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

customer_uuid.description: Filter bookings to those of a specific customer. Obtain from list_customers.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Get full booking details: customer, services, order amount, status, and cancellation policy.

booking_uuid.description: UUID of the booking. Obtain from list_bookings or get_customer_bookings.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a new booking (appointment). Verify slot availability with get_availability first.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for times in the response (e.g. 'Europe/Berlin'). Defaults to the location's timezone.

reserved_on.description: Booking start time in UTC ISO 8601 format (e.g. '2026-03-30T10:00:00Z'). Verify availability first with get_availability.

service_uuid.description: UUID of the service. Obtain from list_services for the location.

staffer_uuid.description: UUID of a specific staff member. Obtain from list_staff.

location_uuid.description: UUID of the location (branch). Obtain from list_locations.

customer_email.description: Customer's email address. Used for booking confirmations if provided.

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number in E.164 format with country code (e.g. '+491234567890'). Used for booking confirmations.

booking_comment.description: Optional comment or notes to attach to the booking (visible to staff).

customer_first_name.description: Customer's first name. Required for creating a booking.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. This is a destructive action — confirm with the user before calling.

reason.description: Optional reason for cancellation. Stored with the booking for audit.

booking_uuid.description: UUID of the booking. Obtain from list_bookings or get_customer_bookings.

tools.name: complete_booking
tools.description: Mark a booking as completed (service delivered successfully).

booking_uuid.description: UUID of the booking. Obtain from list_bookings or get_customer_bookings.

tools.name: change_booking_status
tools.description: Move a booking to a custom status (e.g. 'Confirmed', 'No-show'). Use list_booking_statuses first.

status_uuid.description: UUID of the target status. Obtain from list_booking_statuses. For system statuses use cancel_booking or complete_booking instead.

booking_uuid.description: UUID of the booking. Obtain from list_bookings or get_customer_bookings.

tools.name: update_booking_notes
tools.description: Replace the public comment/notes on a booking. Visible to staff and in client notifications.

booking_uuid.description: UUID of the booking. Obtain from list_bookings or get_customer_bookings.

public_notes.description: New public comment text attached to the booking. Replaces existing notes.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Move a booking to a new date/time. Preserves customer, services, and payment; only the time changes.

reserved_on.description: New start time in UTC ISO 8601 (e.g. '2026-04-10T14:00:00Z'). Verify availability with get_availability first.

booking_uuid.description: UUID of the booking. Obtain from list_bookings or get_customer_bookings.

send_notification.description: If true, notify the customer about the reschedule via their configured channels. Defaults to true.

tools.name: list_booking_statuses
tools.description: List booking statuses available in this workspace. Use to resolve status UUIDs for change_booking_status.

include_system.description: If true, also return system statuses (Successful, Unsuccessful, Reserved) in addition to assignable custom statuses.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the workspace, paginated, with names, contacts, and profile fields.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Get full customer details: name, phone, email, birthday, company info, and messaging contacts.

customer_uuid.description: UUID of the customer. Obtain from list_customers.

tools.name: get_customer_bookings
tools.description: Get booking history for a customer, paginated, sorted by date descending (newest first).

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting at 1.

customer_uuid.description: UUID of the customer. Obtain from list_customers.

prompts.name: book_appointment
prompts.description: Guide the user through booking a new appointment end-to-end.

arguments.name: service
arguments.description:
Service name or description the customer wants to book (e.g. 'haircut').

Provide as a JSON string matching the following schema: {"description":"Service name or description the customer wants to book (e.g. 'haircut').","type":"string"}

arguments.name: when
arguments.description:
Desired date or time in natural language (e.g. 'tomorrow at 14:00', 'next Monday morning').

Provide as a JSON string matching the following schema: {"description":"Desired date or time in natural language (e.g. 'tomorrow at 14:00', 'next Monday morning').","type":"string"}

arguments.name: customer
arguments.description:
Customer name and phone number (e.g. 'Anna Mueller, +491234567890').

Provide as a JSON string matching the following schema: {"description":"Customer name and phone number (e.g. 'Anna Mueller, +491234567890').","type":"string"}

prompts.name: find_next_slot
prompts.description: Find the earliest free time slot for a service.

arguments.name: service
arguments.description:
Service name the customer is interested in (e.g. 'hair coloring').

Provide as a JSON string matching the following schema: {"description":"Service name the customer is interested in (e.g. 'hair coloring').","type":"string"}

prompts.name: check_today_schedule
prompts.description: Show the list of bookings scheduled for today.
